text: Theopompus answered a stranger who talked much of his affection to the Lacedaemonians, and said that his countrymen called him Philolacon (a lover of the Lacedaemonians), that it had been more for his honor if they had called him Philopolites (a lover of his own countrymen).
author: Plutarch
speaker: Theopompus
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
